data.app_name: Extreme Bike Rider - Bike Stunt & Racing Games
data.description:
🏍️ Extreme Bike Rider - Bike Stunt & Racing Games | Virtual Reality Motorcycle Stunt Adventure!

Enter the thrilling world of VR bike stunts and high-speed motorcycle racing with Extreme Bike Rider! Experience the ultimate rush of performing heart-pounding stunts on powerful bikes, from sleek sports bikes to rugged motocross models, as you blaze through urban landscapes, dodge traffic, and unleash daring tricks! 🏁

🌟 Key Features:

🌆 Immersive VR Environments: Feel the intensity as you race through detailed urban streets and rugged motocross-inspired courses, designed to push your stunt skills to the limit.

🏍️ Wide Range of Bikes: Ride a variety of motorcycles, including sports bikes, motocross bikes, and choppers, each offering a unique experience.

🎮 Realistic Bike Physics in VR: Experience lifelike bike handling and physics that make every jump, wheelie, and drift feel true to life in VR.

🔥 Extreme Stunts and Tricks: Perform epic wheelies, flips, and motocross jumps as you take on challenging stunt courses.

🚦 Traffic Dodge Mode: Weave through city traffic while executing daring stunts in VR, challenging your reflexes and riding skills.

🕹️ Intuitive VR Controls: Easy-to-use bike controls optimized for a seamless and immersive VR experience.

Gear up and dive into Extreme Bike Rider - Bike Stunt & Racing Games to conquer daring stunts and VR bike races! Are you ready to hit the throttle and own the road? 🏍️💨
